content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that enables creators to deploy websites directly from their GitHub repositories. This infrastructure allows digital creators to set up an online store for their products, such as ebooks and courses, without the high costs typically associated with conventional platforms. Unlike services like Gumroad, which charge up to 10% on sales, using GitHub Pages with NOWPayments can drastically reduce fees to just 0.5%. This means that for a creator selling 100 products at $97 each, the fee difference retains an impressive $921, which can directly impact revenue and sustainability.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages digital product store leverages several components to function seamlessly. First, you host your website on GitHub Pages, which requires no cost and minimal setup. Combined with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate the order processing and product delivery. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a transaction fee of only 0.5%. This combination allows for real-time currency conversion and instant delivery of digital products, ensuring a smooth experience for both the seller and customer.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions facing payment gateway restrictions. Whether you are an author selling ebooks, a developer offering software plugins, or a designer providing templates, GitHub Pages allows you to establish your store without being dependent on conventional payment platforms. This infrastructure empowers creators to take control of their business models, providing the freedom to accept payments in cryptocurrencies, thus bypassing the limitations of local currencies and traditional banking systems.
Eliminate high platform fees and keep more revenue in your pocket.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective deployment of a GitHub Pages store consists of several components that work in unison. GitHub Pages serves as the front-end, hosting your website. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers automate backend processes, managing order storage and product delivery. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly for payment processing, allowing you to accept various cryptocurrencies. This architecture ensures that you own everything after deployment, with no ongoing fees or subscriptions, providing true infrastructure sovereignty.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your GitHub Pages digital product store, start by creating a GitHub account and setting up a new repository for your site. Next, configure your site using the templates provided in the Complete Builder Kit, which includes everything you need to build and deploy. Integrate Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automation, and set up NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, upload your digital products and launch your store. Each of these steps is crucial for ensuring that your store operates efficiently and effectively.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Get full ownership of your digital store infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all six blueprints plus seven templates needed to set up your digital store efficiently. This kit provides instant access and ensures you're equipped to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. For additional resources, visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your store. Choose a template from the Complete Builder Kit to start building your site. Set up Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for managing order processing and product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency payments. Upload your digital products to your GitHub repository. Launch your store and start selling your products.
